relationship_to_G13: Separate executable pilot. It does not replace or complete the locked G13 data-hash protocol because exact G12/G13 generator bytes are not remotely recoverable from the repository.
hypothesis: With exactly the same pre-sampled minibatch multiset, presenting four difficulty stages in increasing order improves fresh arithmetic+code-trace free-generation exact accuracy versus a deterministic random permutation of the same batches.

arms.shuffled: same exact batches in a fixed random permutation

objective: strict completion-only F=<integer>+EOS; no trace target; no solver/case/gold passed to model or parser
selection: fixed step400 only; no held-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection
primary_metric: mean arithmetic+code_trace IID exact across the two seeds
interpretation: Pilot-scale mechanism evidence only. Even confirmation is not G13 completion, not Qwen parity, and not justification by itself for 300-800M scaling.
